facts.us: Execute workflows without losing committed work or duplicating successful external effects.

facts.canonical: Exporter must not directly depend on or call JobStore.

facts.canonical: JobStore is the sole persistence owner of workflow payload, workflow state, committed result, and per-exporter success receipts.
facts.us: JobStore must be the sole persistence owner of workflow payload, state, committed result, and per-exporter success receipts.

facts.canonical: AuditLog is append-only: later events must not delete, reorder, or mutate earlier audit entries.
facts.us: AuditLog must be append-only; later events must_not delete, reorder, or mutate earlier entries.

facts.canonical: WorkflowService records processing_failed, committed, export_failed, and exported audit events at the corresponding transitions.
facts.us: WorkflowService must record processing_failed, committed, export_failed, and exported audit events at the corresponding transitions.

facts.canonical: Canonical job payload stored by JobStore must not be mutated through aliases passed to Processor or any later collaborator.
facts.us: Canonical JobStore payload must_not be mutated through aliases passed to Processor or later collaborators.

facts.canonical: A committed result stored by JobStore must not be mutated through aliases passed to Exporter or any later collaborator.
facts.us: Committed JobStore result must_not be mutated through aliases passed to Exporter or later collaborators.

facts.canonical: The implementation performs network access.
facts.us: network access must_not occur

facts.canonical: A result is committed before any external export effect for that result is attempted.
facts.us: commit must occur before any export effect for that result.

facts.canonical: Exporter failure after commit does not roll back the committed result or COMMITTED workflow state.
facts.us: export failure after commit must_not roll back the committed result or COMMITTED state.

facts.canonical: For a given job and exporter name, a successfully recorded external export effect occurs at most once, including after later calls, maintenance, retries, or WorkflowService replacement.
facts.us: successful external effect per (job, exporter_name) must occur at most once across later calls, maintenance, retries, and WorkflowService replacement.

facts.canonical: Workflow state skips directly from PENDING to EXPORTED without a committed result.
facts.us: workflow state must_not skip PENDING -> EXPORTED without a committed result.

facts.canonical: NotFound, ProcessingFailure, ExportFailure, and Completed are pairwise distinct observable outcomes.
facts.us: NotFound distinct ProcessingFailure distinct ExportFailure distinct Completed

facts.canonical: A successful exporter receipt remains persisted even if another exporter later fails or a new WorkflowService instance resumes the job.
facts.us: successful exporter receipts must remain persisted across later exporter failure and WorkflowService replacement.

facts.canonical: Internal data structures, subject to all other facts.
facts.us: may_choose internal data structures

facts.canonical: Internal batch partitioning strategy, subject to observable batch semantics and all other facts.
facts.us: may_choose internal batch partitioning strategy

facts.canonical: Private helper classes, functions, and internal file layout beyond the required public trial API.
facts.us: may_choose private helpers and internal file layout beyond the required public API

facts.canonical: AuditLog internal storage and indexing representation, subject to append-only semantics.
facts.us: may_choose AuditLog storage and indexing subject to append-only semantics

facts.canonical: Invocation order among exporters that are still required and have no recorded success, when no other rule or explicit policy constrains that order.
facts.us: may_choose order among still-required exporters with no recorded success when no rule or explicit policy constrains it

facts.canonical: If a job does not exist, return NotFound without calling Processor or Exporter.
facts.us: job missing => NotFound; Processor and Exporter are not called

facts.canonical: If Processor fails while the job is PENDING, append processing_failed, return ProcessingFailure, keep the job PENDING, and do not commit or export.
facts.us: PENDING + Processor failure => append processing_failed; ProcessingFailure; remain PENDING; no commit; no export

facts.canonical: If Processor succeeds while the job is PENDING, commit the result, enter COMMITTED, append committed, and only then attempt export.
facts.us: PENDING + Processor success => commit result; COMMITTED; append committed; then export

facts.canonical: If an attempted required export fails after commit, append export_failed, return ExportFailure, and keep the job COMMITTED.
facts.us: required export failure after commit => append export_failed; ExportFailure; remain COMMITTED

facts.canonical: When every exporter required by the active explicit policy has a persisted success receipt, mark the job EXPORTED, append exported, and return Completed.
facts.us: all explicitly required exporters have persisted success receipts => EXPORTED; append exported; Completed

facts.canonical: If a job is already EXPORTED, return Completed from persisted state without invoking an exporter again.
facts.us: already EXPORTED => Completed from persisted state; no exporter call

facts.canonical: When a COMMITTED multi-export job is resumed, exporters with persisted success receipts are not invoked again; only still-required exporters without success receipts remain eligible.
facts.us: resume COMMITTED multi-export => successful exporters are not called again; only still-required exporters without receipts remain eligible

facts.canonical: The policy that decides which exporters are required when multiple exporters are configured is unresolved. No default all, any, first-success, or best-effort policy may be silently selected.
facts.us: unresolved multi-export required-exporter policy; must_not silently choose all, any, first-success, best-effort, or another default

facts.canonical: Automatic retry policy is unresolved, including which processing/export failures are retryable and how many attempts are allowed. No retry classification or attempt limit may be silently selected.
facts.us: unresolved automatic retry classification and attempt limit; must_not silently choose retryable failures or an attempt count
